format: CSV with one row per attempted trial
block_design: Every acquisition block contains each of the 32 arm-predecessor-target cells exactly once. Across each 32-block rotation superblock, every cell occupies every within-block position exactly once.
retention_rule: Every attempted trial is recorded; reset_failure is an outcome and never an exclusion key.
scope_boundary: Passing this raw predecessor-memory acquisition is necessary but not sufficient; all eight full-suite gates must also pass.
